start.description: The starting value of the sequence.

stop.description: The final value of the sequence, unless `endpoint` is `False`. In that case, `num + 1` values are spaced over the interval in log-space, of which all but the last (a sequence of length `num`) are returned.
constraints: stop must be one of False

num.description: Number of samples to generate. Defaults to `50`.

endpoint.description: If `True`, `stop` is the last sample. Otherwise, it is not included. Defaults to `True`.

base.description: The base of the log space. Defaults to `10`. dtype: The type of the output tensor.

axis.description: The axis in the result to store the samples. Relevant only if start or stop are array-like.

output.description: A tensor of evenly spaced samples on a log scale.
